name: Harbor & Pine Realty
services: Helping buyers find HDB resale flats and condominiums
Selling homes: free valuation, listing, viewings and negotiation
facts: Home valuations are free and take about 30 minutes in person or by video call.
Viewings can be booked 7 days a week between 10 AM and 8 PM.
We work with HDB resale flats and private condominiums; we do not handle commercial or industrial property.
Our commission for sellers is discussed during the valuation; we do not quote commission over chat or email.
Buyers pay no fee to us for HDB resale purchases.
